title: Output length is bounded by the number of steps
statement: Let $tm$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be an input word, and let $t\\in\\mathbb{N}$. The output word in the configuration reached after $t$ steps from the initial configuration of $tm$ on $x$ has length at most $t$.
replaced:
Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be an input
word, and let $t \in \mathbb{N}$.  Then the word written on the output tape
after $M$ runs for $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$ has length
at most $t$.
